notes: Android: the update window no longer runs off the bottom of a landscape phone screen (it blocked every tap). The buttons always stay visible now
Phone in portrait: the card hub (cards, shop, binder, market, profile) no longer spills off the right edge, and the header and bottom bar fit
Fixed the player freezing after a story battle when a chapter scene started at the same moment
Story scenes and area banners wait while the map, Lattice or a menu is open, and the world HUD hides during every cinematic
New player moves: jump take-off and landing, swimming at the surface, climbing steep slopes and opening chests
Card creatures catch the light with a rim of sunlight and soft shading, so they read better in the grass and in battle
Glass silhouettes and other objectives next to rocks can always be reached; the final battle with GLYPH is fairer
Touch players get touch controls in the welcome tip, and the 'open Journey' link in tips can be tapped
